item.title: Craig Bell Celebrates 5 Years with LeavePlus
item.description: Craig marked 5 years with LeavePlus on 20 September. Record employers, workers, claims paid and fund size, a new name and a refurbished office. Thank you to everyone, past and present.

item.title: Craig Back from Leave - Thanks to Catryn
item.description: Craig is back on deck after two weeks' leave. Thanks to Catryn for stepping into the CEO role while he was away.

item.title: AusLeave Annual Conference - Tue 22 & Wed 23 Sep, Brisbane
item.description: Craig joins state CEOs and Chairs from the portable long service leave authorities to discuss industry developments, share insights and review issues affecting our sector.

item.title: Trivia Night - Wed 23 Sep, 4pm-7pm
item.description: A fun night of challenging questions, crazy costumes and some delicious food.

item.title: Yom Kippur - Monday 21 September
item.description: The holiest day of the year for the Jewish people, marked by fasting, intensive prayer, repentance and forgiveness. Also known as the Day of Atonement.

item.title: National Week of Deaf People - 22-28 September
item.description: A national celebration of Deaf people and the Australian Deaf community, including the International Week of Deaf People and International Day of Sign Languages.

item.title: AFL Grand Final: Fremantle v Brisbane - Sat 26 Sep
item.description: Fremantle beat Sydney by 11 and Brisbane beat Hawthorn by 9 in the prelims. Two non-Victorian teams meet at the MCG, with Kylie headlining the pre-match show.

item.title: Guide to People Processes Now on the People Hub
item.description: Find it under People Operations. Use it when onboarding a new starter or cashing out annual leave. Each process sets out the steps and forms you need.

item.title: Register Your Microsoft Passkey by Friday 2 October
item.description: LeavePlus is turning on Microsoft passkeys across Microsoft 365. Sign in with your face, fingerprint or device PIN instead of a password and a code. Full details on CoINVEST News.

item.title: Habitat for Humanity Volunteer Day - Thu 15 October
item.description: The final volunteer day for 2026 is Thursday 15 October. Open to full-time and fixed-term employees. Please consider volunteering for this worthy cause.

item.title: Reminder: Look After the Sit/Stand Desks
item.description: Several desks have needed repair due to misuse. Don't sit on them, lean your full weight against them, or lower them beyond their normal range.

item.title: EOI: Acknowledgement of Country at Town Hall
item.description: Interested in presenting the Acknowledgement of Country at a Town Hall? Let Matt Young know or sign up via the EOI form on Teams.

item.title: New Starter: Fiona Mendes, Program Director, Project Elevate
item.description: Fiona Mendes starts on 24 September as Program Director for Project Elevate. Please join us in making Fiona feel welcome to LeavePlus.

item.title: Benefit Spotlight: Christmas Shutdown Leave
item.description: LeavePlus provides up to 1.5 days of special paid leave over the Christmas shutdown, so you use less annual leave and everyone gets a good break.

item.title: Catch Up on Town Hall Presentations
item.description: Missed a Town Hall? All presentations are available on The Hub.

item.title: Looking for a New Role? Check Team Tailor
item.description: Now open: Paralegal, Consultant - Member Benefits, Investigations Lead, and Delivery Lead (referrals only). Apply via Team Tailor with your LeavePlus email.

item.title: Seen a Colleague Living Our Values? LOVE Awards
item.description: Nominate a colleague for a LOVE Award. Past winners are listed in the Hall of Fame on the CoINVEST News site.

item.title: Got Feedback? Submit It Anytime
item.description: Share feedback through the staff feedback form and someone will be in touch.

item.title: All Staff Teams Channel - Announcements & Shoutouts
item.description: For any updates you may have missed - announcements, events and shoutouts - head to the All Staff Teams channel.
